name: Acme Plumbing & Heating
greeting: Thanks for calling Acme Plumbing and Heating, this is Sam.

service_area.note: Homes and small businesses in Sandpoint, Idaho and the towns around it: north to Bonners Ferry, south to Athol and Bayview, west to Priest River and Priest Lake, and east to Clark Fork.

services.name: Leak, pipe and fixture repair: leaking pipes, dripping faucets, running or leaking toilets
Water heater repair or replacement, tank and tankless
New fixture installation: putting in a new or replacement faucet, toilet or other fixture
Free estimate for a replacement or remodel

not_offered: Appliance repair such as dishwashers or washing machines
pricing: Service visits have an $89 diagnostic fee, which is waived if the customer approves the repair.
A furnace or AC tune-up is $129.
Estimates for water heater or furnace replacement and for remodels are free.
Emergency visits on nights, Sundays and holidays add a $150 after-hours fee.
We don't quote repair or replacement prices over the phone. The technician gives a firm price on site before any work starts.

booking.note: Each service is its own booking. Two services can go in the same window if it's open, or in different windows; the caller chooses.

office.label: the office (Dana, the owner, or dispatch)
office.when: During business hours only: emergencies, an upset customer, or a caller who asks for a person.

on_call.label: the on-call technician
on_call.when: Outside business hours, for emergencies only.

faqs.a: Yes. Acme is a licensed master plumber and fully insured.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you take?
faqs.a: Credit and debit cards, checks and cash. The technician takes payment when the job is done.
Yes, for water heater and furnace replacements. The technician can go over the options.
Labor is guaranteed for one year. Parts carry the manufacturer's warranty.
Most major brands of water heaters, furnaces and boilers, including tankless units.
Yes. The technician calls or texts about 30 minutes before arriving.

faqs.q: Do you work on rental properties?
faqs.a: Yes. For a tenant's call, the landlord or property manager has to approve the repair.

faqs.q: Does someone need to be home for the visit?
faqs.a: Yes. An adult needs to be home for the whole window to let the technician in.

never_say: Never promise an arrival time narrower than the booked two-hour window.
Never guess what is wrong or say a problem is probably minor.
Never offer discounts, coupons or promotions.

approved_tips.when: a slow leak or drip under a sink
approved_tips.tip: You can turn off the small valve under the sink and keep a bucket or towel under it in the meantime.

approved_tips.when: a toilet that keeps running or leaks
approved_tips.tip: You can turn off the valve on the wall behind the toilet, clockwise, to stop the water in the meantime.
Please don't use chemical drain cleaners on it; they can damage the pipes and make the repair unsafe.

approved_tips.when: no hot water from an electric water heater
approved_tips.tip: You can check whether the water heater's breaker has tripped and switch it back on once; if it trips again, leave it off.

approved_tips.when: a tankless water heater showing an error code
approved_tips.tip: Please write down the error code; you can also turn the unit off and back on once at its power switch.

approved_tips.when: a furnace that won't come on
approved_tips.tip: You can check that the thermostat is set to heat, that its batteries aren't dead, and that the switch on or near the furnace is on.

approved_tips.when: a frozen pipe that hasn't burst
approved_tips.tip: You can open the faucet a little and keep that area warm, but please don't use an open flame to thaw it.
